age.evidence: Adult male Wistar Han rats (280-350 g; Charles River, Sulzfeld, Germany) were used in all the experiments.

sex.evidence: Adult male Wistar Han rats (280-350 g; Charles River, Sulzfeld, Germany) were used in all the experiments.

dosing.evidence: psilocybin was synthesized at the Department of Medicinal Chemistry... both were dissolved in sterile water... All drugs were given intraperitoneally (ip) in the volume of 2 mL/kg.
Ketamine hydrochloride was purchased from Tocris... both were dissolved in sterile water... All drugs were given intraperitoneally (ip) in the volume of 2 mL/kg.

handling.evidence: Rats were handled once daily before the beginning of the experiments

group_housing.evidence: The animals were initially acclimatized and housed (6 per cage) in environmentally controlled rooms

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12:12 light:dark cycle (direction/phase of testing not stated)

enrichment_housing.evidence: an enriched environment was not applied

assays.assay_description: Round black arena (1 m diameter), virtually divided into eight sections, dimly lit room with centre illuminated; 10-min recording 24 h after a single i.p. dose of psilocybin (2 or 10 mg/kg), ketamine (10 mg/kg) or saline. Methods list walking time, line crossings, peeping, grooming and rearing; results report walking time and crossings.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were given intraperitoneally (ip) in the volume of 2 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: No pre-test exposure to the open field arena is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in the middle of the arena... Their behavior was recorded for 10 min.

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the open field arena during the 10-min test; home cage food was ad libitum.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the open field arena during the 10-min test; home cage water was ad libitum.

time_to_assay.evidence: Section 2.5: 'Rat Behavior in the Open Field... Tests 24 h after Administration'; Figure 5: '24 h after administration'. Note Methods 4.7 states 'Rats were placed in the middle of the arena 20 min after drugs injection' — conflicting.

sample_size.evidence: Inferred from error df: 'F 3,35 = 39, p < 0.0001' (4 groups); per-group n only shown in figure, not in text.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin (2 and 10 mg/kg) did not affect walking time or number of line crossings in the open field 24 h after administration, whereas ketamine (10 mg/kg) decreased both parameters.
outcomes.statistics: F(3,35) = 39, p < 0.0001 (walking time); F(3,35) = 6.4, p < 0.01 (crossings); one-way ANOVA with Tukey post hoc
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin did not affect time of walking and episodes of crossing in the open field test; however, ketamine decreased both parameters in this test (F 3,35 = 39, p < 0.0001, F 3,35 = 6.4, p < 0.01, respectively; one-way ANOVA) (Figure 5A,B).

B1_num_measures.evidence: Results report only 'time of walking and episodes of crossing' (Figure 5A,B); peeping, grooming and rearing listed in Methods but not reported as results.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only session totals reported; no within-session time course.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No transition or sequence analysis reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Reported results are walking time and line crossings only; grooming/rearing mentioned in Methods but no data reported.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: No pose estimation or ML behavioural classifier described.

B8_multivariate.evidence: 'The results obtained in the open field test... were analyzed with one-way ANOVA'

E1_environment_type.evidence: A round black arena (1 m in diameter)

E6_spatial.evidence: was virtually divided into eight sections, creating a wheel

E7_social_context.evidence: Rats were placed in the middle of the arena (individual testing).

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in arena.

D1_continuity.evidence: Their behavior was recorded for 10 min.

D2_session_duration.evidence: Their behavior was recorded for 10 min.

D5_followup.evidence: The Effect of Psilocybin and Ketamine on Rat Behavior in the Open Field... 24 h after Administration

assays.assay_description: TSE Fear Conditioning System cage (45 × 45 × 45 cm) with clear light compartment (100 lx) and black dark compartment (33% of area) connected by tunnel gate; single 10-min trial 24 h after drug; time in each compartment, distance travelled per zone and transitions measured with TSE software.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were given intraperitoneally (ip) in the volume of 2 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: Only room/dark acclimation: 'The animals were kept in total darkness for 1 h prior to the testing' — no apparatus pre-exposure.

setup_restrain.evidence: The animals were individually tested in single 10 min trials... a rat was placed in the center of the light compartment

food_restriction.evidence: No food described in the light-dark box during testing.

water_restriction.evidence: No water described in the light-dark box during testing.

time_to_assay.evidence: activity of rats in the light-dark box (LDB) test 24 h after administration

sample_size.evidence: Two-way ANOVA F 3,72 (treatment × zone); per-group n given only in figure, not in text.

outcomes.summary: No treatment altered time spent in the light vs. dark compartments (no anxiolytic/anxiogenic effect). Psilocybin 2 mg/kg and ketamine decreased ambulatory distance in both zones, whereas psilocybin 10 mg/kg had no effect.
outcomes.statistics: Time: treatment F(3,72) = 0, p < 1.0; zone F(1,72) = 919, p < 0.0001; interaction F(3,72) = 1.17, p < 0.32. Distance: treatment F(3,72) = 17.4, p < 0.0001; zone F(1,72) = 412, p < 0.0001; interaction F(3,72) = 1.73, p < 0.16 (two-way ANOVA, Tukey)
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin at a dose of 2 mg/kg and ketamine significantly decreased exploration of the dark and light zones. Two-way ANOVA showed the effect of treatment (F 3,72 = 17.4, p < 0.0001)

B1_num_measures.evidence: Results report time spent in light/dark zones and ambulatory distance per zone (Figure 5C,D); transitions measured but not reported.

B4_ethological.evidence: Only zone time and distance measured.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: recorded using Fear Conditioning software (TSE) — position/activity tracking, not a behavioural classifier

B8_multivariate.evidence: The data collected from the LDB test were analyzed with the two-way ANOVA

E1_environment_type.evidence: each experimental cage included an arena (45 × 45 × 45 cm) with a light compartment... and a dark compartment

E2_shelter.evidence: a dark compartment made of black acrylic... the dark compartment received no light at all

E6_spatial.evidence: the black dividing wall was equipped with a central tunnel gate (11 × 8.4 cm)

E7_social_context.evidence: The animals were individually tested in single 10 min trials.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water described in apparatus.

D1_continuity.evidence: The animals were individually tested in single 10 min trials.

D5_followup.evidence: light-dark box (LDB) test 24 h after administration

assays.assay_description: Porsolt rat FST: cylinder (50 cm high × 23 cm diameter) filled to 30 cm with water (25 °C); 15-min pre-test on day 1, 5-min retest 24 h later scored by two blinded observers for immobility, swimming and climbing; testing 24 h after drug.

application_type.evidence: All drugs were given intraperitoneally (ip) in the volume of 2 mL/kg.

setup_habituation.evidence: On the first day of the FST (pre-test), the rats were placed individually in a cylinder... for 15 min

setup_restrain.evidence: FST cylinder: 'placed individually in a cylinder (50 cm high × 23 cm in diameter) filled to a 30 cm depth with water'

food_restriction.evidence: No food accessible in swim cylinder.

water_restriction.evidence: No drinking water accessible in swim cylinder.

time_to_assay.evidence: time of rats in the forced swim test (FST) estimated 24 h after administration

sample_size.evidence: Inferred from error df: 'immobility time (F 3,76 = 8.12, p < 0.0001)' (4 groups); per-group n only in figure.

outcomes.summary: Psilocybin 2 mg/kg increased immobility and swimming time and decreased climbing time 24 h after dosing; psilocybin 10 mg/kg had no significant effect; ketamine only increased swimming. No treatment reduced immobility (no antidepressant-like effect).
outcomes.statistics: Immobility F(3,76) = 8.12, p < 0.0001; climbing F(3,76) = 15, p < 0.0001; swimming F(3,76) = 27, p < 0.0001 (one-way ANOVA, Tukey); ^ p < 0.05 psilocybin 2 vs 10 mg/kg
outcomes.evidence: Psilocybin at a dose of 2 mg/kg significantly increased immobility and swimming time (Figure 6A,C), while significantly decreasing climbing time (Figure 6B). Ketamine only significantly increased swimming time (Figure 6C).

B1_num_measures.evidence: measured the swimming, climbing and immobility time

B4_ethological.evidence: FST immobility/climbing/swimming are not ethological measures per rubric.

B5_social.evidence: rats were placed individually in a cylinder

B6_cognitive.evidence: Behavioural despair test; no learning measure.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Retest sessions were evaluated by two observers who were unaware of the treatment condition

B8_multivariate.evidence: forced swim test... analyzed with one-way ANOVA

E1_environment_type.evidence: cylinder (50 cm high × 23 cm in diameter)

E7_social_context.evidence: rats were placed individually in a cylinder

D1_continuity.evidence: Only the retest was scored: 'Retest sessions were evaluated by two observers'; pre-test data not reported.

D2_session_duration.evidence: the rats were retested for five minutes under identical conditions

D3_recording_days.evidence: Behavioural data collected only on the retest day.

D4_baseline.evidence: 15-min pre-test served as habituation; no data reported from it.

D5_followup.evidence: forced swim test (FST) estimated 24 h after administration

judge_notes: All candidates agreed on three behavioural assays (OFT, LDB, FST); microdialysis, comet assay and Western blot excluded as non-behavioural.

B1 for OFT and LDB set to 2-3 (score 1): only walking time/crossings (OFT) and zone time/distance (LDB) are reported as results; Methods-only parameters (peeping, grooming, rearing, transitions) not counted. Gemma's score 2 with value '2-3' was internally inconsistent.
OFT B4 kept at modal 0 because grooming/rearing data were never reported, though Methods say they were quantified.

FST D1/D3/D4 overridden to single session/1 day/no baseline (following qwen): paper states only 'Retest sessions were evaluated'; the 15-min pre-test was habituation with no data reported. D2 = 5-min retest (score 0).

D5 scored 1 for all assays: abstract, Section 2.5 title and figure legends state testing 24 h after administration. OFT Methods conflictingly say '20 min after drugs injection'; 24 h adopted with medium confidence.
Psilocybin vehicle set to water ('both were dissolved in sterile water'); controls received 0.9% NaCl. Ketamine included as an administered comparator; MDMA excluded (comet assay only).
Sample sizes for OFT and FST inferred from ANOVA error df (low confidence); LDB n left null due to ambiguous two-way design.
